text: Find Olant and Potumkin who went missing in Zarth's Mansion!
Go to the back of the mansion and defeat the evil thing that\nlooks like Jeila's father!

Fulfill Jeila and Zarth's request to collect sweets
ingredients for fixing Zoe's mood!

You can get [ffff64]Apple[ffffff] from Coryn in Douce Hamlet, [ffff64]Egg[ffffff] from Pojo
in Darkanon Plain, and [ffff64]Glowing Dust[ffffff] from Roar in
Ruined Temple.
